plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for CyberPower ePDU2 rack PDU and environment probes (CPS-MIB, enterprise PEN 3808). It reports uptime, whole-device current and power, environment temperature and humidity when a probe is present, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_device_current_amps
metrics.description: Whole-device current of the CyberPower ePDU2 in amperes, from ePDU2DeviceStatusCurrentLoad (1.3.6.1.4.1.3808.1.1.6.3.4.1.5, tenths of amperes, divided by 10). Absent rows are dropped.

metrics.name: pdu_device_power_watts
metrics.description: Whole-device power of the CyberPower ePDU2 in watts, from ePDU2DeviceStatusPowerLoad (1.3.6.1.4.1.3808.1.1.6.3.4.1.18). Absent rows are dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Environment temperature of the CyberPower ePDU2 in degrees Celsius, from envirTemperatureCelsius (1.3.6.1.4.1.3808.1.1.4.2.6.0, tenths of a degree, divided by 10). Missing probes are omitted rather than reported as zero.

metrics.name: snmp_env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Environment relative humidity of the CyberPower ePDU2 in percent, from envirHumidity (1.3.6.1.4.1.3808.1.1.4.3.1.0). Missing probes are omitted rather than reported as zero.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
